rounds.q: How old is the typical American man at his first wedding?
rounds.why: The exact figure is 30.8, and 28.4 for women. In 1975 it was 23.5 for men.
rounds.src: US Census Bureau, Families and Living Arrangements (2025 data)
rounds.fun: Grooms now wait until 30.8, up from 23.5 in 1975. No rush, fellas!

rounds.q: How many guests are at the average US wedding?
rounds.why: Couples spent an average of $292 on each guest.
rounds.src: The Knot, 2026 Real Weddings Study (10,474 couples married in 2025)
rounds.fun: 117 guests at $292 each. That is one very generous party!

rounds.q: CDC's handwashing timer: hum Happy Birthday twice. At least how many seconds?
rounds.why: The CDC says to scrub for at least 20 seconds, and humming the song twice start to finish is its timer.
rounds.src: CDC, About Handwashing (scrub for at least 20 seconds)
rounds.fun: Hum Happy Birthday twice and you have scrubbed for at least 20 seconds. Clean hands!

rounds.q: About how many babies are born in the US on an average day?
rounds.why: A provisional count of 3,606,400 US births in 2025 works out to about 9,881 a day.
rounds.src: CDC National Center for Health Statistics, Births: Provisional Data for 2025
rounds.fun: About 9,881 brand new birthdays every single day. Happy first one, little ones!

rounds.q: In a party of 23 people, what's the % chance two share a birthday?
rounds.why: The exact chance is 50.7%. With 57 guests it climbs past 99%.
rounds.src: Wolfram MathWorld, Birthday Problem (0.507297 for 23 people; 57-person figure computed from its formula)
rounds.fun: Just 23 guests and it is better than a coin flip at 50.7%. Check the cake!
